summary: Public Service Electric & Gas Company filed a 424B5 pricing supplement for a $350 million offering of 6.050% secured medium-term notes due 2056. The notes were priced at 99.961% of principal, with net proceeds of approximately $347.2 million. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. The filing includes standard risk factors, a tax credit event redemption feature, and underwriter details. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist, or other special-situation event. The registrant acts solely as issuer of fixed-income securities.
